name: hero-rooftop-mixed
brief:
A ninja's hero shot on a flat rooftop, about 12 seconds, one continuous take.

The set, in metres. The character starts at x 0, z 0, facing +z; +x is to its left. Distances 'along the route' are measured from that start.
- A curved ledge runs from the start for 2.6 m. It begins heading +z and bends steadily to the LEFT, so that where it ends the route points 50 degrees left of +z. (An arc of radius 3 m: after turning by an angle a, a point on it is at x = 3 * (1 - cos a), z = 3 * sin a.)
- From the end of the ledge the roof runs dead straight, in that same direction, for 9 m.
- A wall stands across the route 8.6 m along it: 0.75 m high, 0.3 m thick. The character's hips pass over the wall exactly at 8.6 m, and the hand that vaults is planted on the wall's top there.
- It lands 1.4 m past the wall, at 10.0 m, and stays there to the end.

The character carries a katana in a scabbard on its back, grip over the right shoulder. It draws with the right hand in the last beat.

The camera tracks from ahead of the character and 45 degrees to its right, at three-quarter view, about 5.5 m away. It drops low for the landing, then comes back up. For the last pose the character turns to face that camera: 45 degrees to the RIGHT of the route.

This is the mixed cut of the same shot: the crouch, the landing and the draw are our own poses; the sneak, the run and the vault are each made from a sentence. Same set, same beats, same length.

beats.action: crouched on the roof edge, looks left, then right
sneaks along the curved ledge, low
beats.driven_by: text: a sentence for Kimodo, held to the ledge's curve; it starts from our crouch
text: a sentence for Kimodo, along the straight roof

beats.action: vaults the 0.75 m wall, one hand on top
beats.driven_by: text: a sentence for Kimodo, with the right hand of our vault_over pose on the wall top
land_three_point, both feet and the left hand pinned

beats.action: rises, draws the katana, ends facing the camera
beats.driven_by: rise, draw, hero_stance; the sword goes from the back to the right hand
